justification: Response misapplies atmospheric attenuation to inter‑satellite links, claims V‑band has higher latency and lower power consumption without basis, and fails to discuss orbital geometry (LEO‑LEO, GEO‑GEO, cross‑link distances) that would justify V‑band over optical. Technical statements are largely inaccurate, only loosely echoing reference. No clear decision or actionable guidance is provided.
